selected_problem: After normalized slash aliases were closed on fresh main, semantic graph path identity still treated src/a.js and src/./a.js as distinct nodes even though relative import normalization resolves dot segments. The mismatch can inflate graph stats, ranking and bounded context selection.
change: Extend semantic graph lexical path identity normalization to remove explicit dot path segments while preserving parent-segment, case and Unicode semantics.
truth_boundary: This closes explicit dot-segment aliases such as src/./a.js and ./src/a.js under the existing graph path model. Parent-segment equivalence, repeated separators, filesystem case/Unicode identity, conflicting content aliases, complete parser-grade module resolution and arbitrary complex repository synthesis remain unresolved.
